coordination_summary: Five agent sessions have worked in this repository on 2026-10-22. arena/b4413b13-gold4 (PR #1, #3), arena/93da71b4-gold4 (PR #2) and arena/9614479d-gold4 (PR #4, #5) built the dataset, the site and the audit; arena/22b5b06c-gold4's review is preserved unmerged at docs/legacy/. This pass is arena/fd51d093-gold4, which took the published tree and re-verified it line by line against the official sources rather than trusting it. Nothing from any other branch was deleted, renamed or force-pushed.

checked: git log: a single commit, 'Initial commit'
Tracked files: README.md only, 7 bytes, contents '# GOLD4'
No data, no site, no sources, no tests, no workflows
GitHub Pages already enabled and building from main / (root), html_url https://karagemop466-tech.github.io/GOLD4/
No open issues, no pull requests, one successful pages-build-deployment run
git ls-remote: three other arena/* branches exist, all with claims boards but no data files
passes.outcome: Nothing in the repository could be verified because nothing existed; all findings on this site are new work. Recorded the four-session collision in COORDINATION.md before writing any file.

passes.pass: Pass 1 — source capture (benchmark, law, retailer pages)
passes.scope: Official sources only: FTC, eCFR, U.S. Code, World Gold Council, LBMA, and retailer product/policy pages
checked: World Gold Council gold spot: USD 4,024.36/oz, data as of 21 October 2026 — read from the page's own spot panel
LBMA: benchmark description read; no numerical LBMA price captured because the tables are behind an IBA licence
FTC consumer article: karat definition, solid-gold definition, trademark-beside-karat-mark requirement, plated/filled/vermeil definitions
16 CFR Part 23 § 23.3: gold-content misrepresentation and the ban on calling a hollow-centre item 'solid'
15 U.S.C. § 295: 0.003 assay tolerance and 0.007 whole-article tolerance
FTC credit-card article: billing-error dispute rights
20 retailer product pages fetched: Blue Nile (8), Allurez (4 + policy), VRAI (2 + listing + returns), Mejuri (collection + returns), Anjolee (1), Brilliant Earth (1, policy only)
Every price and weight recorded was copied from the fetched page text, not from search snippets
passes.outcome: Six rows carry a published gram weight (Allurez ×4, VRAI ×2). Nineteen rows carry a price read from the seller's page. Brilliant Earth produced policy facts but no readable price/weight, so it has no product row and no price is quoted anywhere.

passes.pass: Pass 2 — dataset assembly + first integrity audit
checked: Karat fineness table = karat ÷ 24, cross-checked against the FTC karat definition
Legal minimum fineness per stamp = fineness − 0.007 (15 U.S.C. § 295)
Derived gold grams, gold value, legal-minimum value and price/gold multiple recomputed independently by the audit script
Phantom-math check: no derived value may exist for a row without a published weight
Blank-value checks: blank price requires PRICE_UNVERIFIED, blank weight requires NO_WEIGHT_PUBLISHED or WEIGHT_UNVERIFIED
Domain allow-list: every source URL must belong to the named retailer or a government/benchmark host
Banned-domain scan: no marketplace, resale, blog or social domain anywhere in the data
Speculation-language scan on all free-text fields

Two real inconsistencies found on Blue Nile's own pages (18k copy on a 14K page; white-gold copy on a yellow-gold page) and one mixed-metal ambiguity (platinum prongs on a 14K ring) — published on the Flagged page instead of being smoothed over
passes.outcome: Two audit bugs were found and fixed (fineness rounding tolerance, derived-value rounding). The audit now re-derives every number and fails on any mismatch.

checked: Builder formats only values produced by compute.py — no arithmetic in the HTML layer
Every table row carries data-row-id and a source link in a td.src cell
Internal links resolve to files that exist; external links are https and on approved domains
No placeholder tokens rendered in any page
No-hallucination block rendered at the top of every page, with a link back to the Flagged page
passes.outcome: Site generated and link-checked by the same audit script that checks the data, so a broken source link fails the build.

passes.pass: Pass 4 — independent line-by-line re-verification of the published tree
passes.scope: Every published value: 20 retailer product pages, 4 retailer return/returns-and-exchanges policies, the Anjolee spec sheet, the World Gold Council spot panel, LBMA, the FTC jewellery article, 16 CFR 23.3 and 15 U.S.C. § 295
checked: BN-01 to BN-08 re-fetched from bluenile.com: all 8 setting prices ($1,000 / $1,155 / $1,000 / $935 / $1,310 / $1,295 / $870 / $1,500), all 8 karat labels and all 8 stock numbers and widths match the dataset
BN-04: the product description again says 'crafted in 18k yellow gold' on the 14K page — COPY_INCONSISTENT_METAL re-confirmed on the live page
BN-07: the description again says the ring has 'platinum prongs' — MIXED_METAL_UNCLEAR re-confirmed
BN-08: the description again says 'set in 14k white gold' on the 14K yellow-gold page — COPY_INCONSISTENT_METAL re-confirmed
AL-01 to AL-04 re-fetched from allurez.com: $585 / $724 / $848 / $1,425 and 'Approximate Metal Weight 3.58 / 3.4 / 4.4 / 5.3 grams' all match

VR-01, VR-02 re-fetched from vrai.com: 'Metal weight:2.86g (Ring size 6)' and 'Metal weight:2.84g (Ring size 6)' match; 'From $1,035' re-read on the VRAI engagement-rings listing card; the Signature 6-prong design page still shows no setting price, so VR-02's blank price is correct
MJ-01 to MJ-05 re-read on the 14k Yellow Gold Rings collection page: $548 / $648 / $548 / $798 / $598 match, each on its own yellow-gold card, and the 'Solid Yellow Gold (14k)' wording is present

AN-01 re-fetched from anjolee.com: 'Price:$870.76' for '14K White Gold, Carat: 0.50 ct, Diamond Color: FG, Diamond Clarity: VS' matches — and the Product Details table DOES publish 'Approx. Metal Weight: 2.90 Gr.', which the previous pass recorded as unreadable
AN-01 spec sheet (MS354-A.pdf, anjolee.com): 2.9 Gr for the 0.50 ct size — corroborates the 2.90 g figure

AN-01 correction: the same Product Details table states 'Center Diamond Color: Lab Created FG' and 'Center Diamond Clarity: Lab Created VS' — the centre stone is lab-created, which the previous price_basis did not say
New flag SPEC_LISTED_PAVE_ON_PLAIN_BAND on VR-01 and VR-02: both pages have 'Band: Plain band' selected while the Setting Details block still lists 'Pave carat weight:0.18ctw'

Blue Nile returns policy re-fetched: 30 days from shipment, two complimentary returns per customer per year, RMA required, $150 missing-grading-report fee, one free resize up/down two sizes within 6 months, and the resized/engraved/custom/clearance exclusions all match the recorded seller facts

Allurez returns policy re-fetched: return must arrive within 30 days of shipment, engraved non-refundable, Design Your Own exchange-only, custom-made non-refundable and non-cancellable, contoured bands not returnable, $300 per missing certificate, 7-business-day refund — all match

VRAI returns page re-fetched: 30 days, under $15,000 refund minus recycling fee or store credit, above $15,000 store credit only, $300 engagement-ring / $50 wedding-band / $50 made-to-order recycling fee, resized and custom items excluded, free US return shipping, 14 business days, one complimentary resize up to one full US size — all match

Mejuri returns terms re-fetched: free 30-day returns in US/CA/UK/AU/DE from delivery or pickup, engraved and monogrammed never returnable, final sale and gift cards excluded, SCS certificate required for lab-grown returns, EU $20 / Rest of World $30 return fee, no online exchanges — all match; no telephone number appears on the page, so the blank phone field is correct

World Gold Council spot panel re-read: USD 4,028.53/oz with 'Data as of 21 October, 2026'. The earlier same-day capture in this repo read 4,024.36/oz. The live panel had moved 0.10% between reads, so both readings are recorded and the dataset now uses the value this pass actually saw

LBMA page re-fetched: the LBMA Gold Price is set twice daily in auctions administered by ICE Benchmark Administration commencing at 10:30 and 15:00 London time, and the tabulated history is behind an IBA licence — the recorded claim matches, and no LBMA number is quoted anywhere

FTC jewellery article re-fetched: karat = parts of 24, 18K = 18 parts gold to 6 parts other metal, trademark must sit beside the karat mark ('if you do not see a trademark along with the karat mark, don't buy it'), 'solid gold' means the item is not hollow, and the definitions of gold filled / overlay / RGP / electroplate (0.175 microns) / vermeil / gold flashed all match

16 CFR 23.3 re-fetched: (a) misrepresenting gold content or karat fineness is deceptive; (c)(1) a hollow-centre article must disclose the hollow centre and must not be described as 'solid' (e.g. not '14 Kt. Solid Gold'); (c)(2) mechanical plating needs 1/40, 'Gold Filled' needs 1/20; (c)(3) electroplate needs 0.175 microns — all match what the site states

15 U.S.C. § 295 re-fetched: 0.003 below the stamped fineness for the assayed part, and 0.007 for the entire article including solder except watchcases and flatware — the '18K may be 74.3% and 14K may be 57.63%' arithmetic re-derives correctly from that section
FTC credit-card article re-fetched: the right to dispute billing errors, the issuer's investigation duty, and the separate section on complaints about the quality of something bought — matches
passes.outcome: Every price in the table was re-read on the retailer's own live page and every one matched. Three substantive changes were made rather than carried forward: (1) AN-01's gram weight is now recorded (2.90 g) because the live Product Details table does publish it; (2) AN-01's centre stone is now recorded as lab-created, which changes how its price may be compared; (3) the gold benchmark is updated to the reading this pass actually saw, with the earlier same-day reading kept in prior_captures. Two new spec-block inconsistencies on the VRAI plain-band pages are flagged rather than resolved.

passes.pass: Pass 5 — line-by-line re-verification of every row, plus new Brilliant Earth rows
passes.scope: All 20 published rows re-opened again, all 6 seller policy pages, and every Tier A/B legal and benchmark source, each compared field by field; Brilliant Earth product pages opened for the first time
checked: Blue Nile: all 8 product pages re-opened. Stock numbers, metal, width and the '(Setting Price)' figures matched exactly ($1,000 / $1,155 / $1,000 / $935 / $1,310 / $1,295 / $870 / $1,500). No page publishes a gram weight. The 14K Comfort Fit copy still says 'crafted in 18k yellow gold' against a 14K spec; the 14K Riviera Pavé copy still says 'set in 14k white gold' against a 14K Yellow Gold title; the Four Prong page still mentions 'platinum prongs'. All three flags stand.
Allurez: all 4 product pages re-opened. $585 / $724 / $848 / $1,425 and 'Approximate Metal Weight' 3.58 g / 3.4 g / 4.4 g / 5.3 g matched.

VRAI: both configuration pages re-opened. Metal weights 2.86 g and 2.84 g (ring size 6) matched. The listing card still reads 'From $1,035', but it links to a different configuration id than the row does — flagged. The Signature 6 Prong still shows no price, so VR-02 stays blank.

Because the same URL can open on a different colourway (white gold on two products, sterling silver on one), PRICE_VARIANT_DEPENDENT was added to MJ-01/MJ-03 and PRICE_IS_FROM_PRICE to MJ-05.

Brilliant Earth: opened for the first time. The Atelier Solitaire pages display readable setting prices ($1,190 in 14K and $1,390 in 18K yellow gold) where the earlier pass could read none, so BE-01 and BE-02 were added with blank weights (no gram weight is published). The page badge now reads 'Free 1-Year Resizing' where the earlier capture described one complimentary resize within 60 days — recorded as an inconsistency, not overwritten.

Anjolee: product page re-opened. $870.76 matched, and the Product Details table was found to publish 'Approx. Metal Weight: 2.90 Gr.' for the 0.50 ct model at ring size 6.5, together with 'Center Diamond Color: Lab Created FG' and 'Clarity: Lab Created VS'. This independently confirms Pass 2's correction and the row keeps its weight, its lab-created-stone note and its not-comparable-to-setting-only warning.

Seller policies re-read in full: Blue Nile returns (30 days from shipment, seven exclusions, two complimentary returns per year, RMA, $150 missing-report fee, one free resize up or down two sizes within 6 months); Allurez returns (must ARRIVE within 30 days of shipment, $300 per missing certificate, 7-business-day refund, Design Your Own exchange-only, custom orders non-refundable and non-cancellable); VRAI returns ($300 engagement-ring recycling fee waived for store credit, 30 days, the $15,000 split, 14 business days, one complimentary resize up to one full US size, EU/EEA withdrawal exclusions); Mejuri returns terms (free 30-day returns in five countries, engraved non-returnable 'at any time', SCS certificate required, no online exchanges, $20 EU / $30 rest-of-world return fees); Anjolee returns and lifetime warranty as quoted. Every clause rendered on the Sellers page traced back to the seller's own page.
Mejuri warranty: the product pages state a two-year warranty, so the blank seller field was filled and WARRANTY_NOT_CAPTURED removed.

Tier A sources re-read: FTC 'Buying Platinum, Gold, and Silver Jewelry'; FTC 'Using Credit Cards and Disputing Charges'; 16 CFR Part 23 (§ 23.3(a), § 23.3(c)(1), § 23.18 heading); 15 U.S.C. § 295 (0.003 assay tolerance, 0.007 whole-article tolerance).

Tier B benchmark: the World Gold Council panel was read again and reproduced the same drift recorded in Pass 2 ($4,028.53/oz on the later read against $4,024.36/oz earlier, both under 'Data as of 21 October, 2026'), confirming that the panel is live and that freezing one read is necessary.

Nothing was added to any row from memory, from a search snippet, from a blog, or from arithmetic on a value the retailer never published. Two rows with a blank weight stayed blank rather than borrowing a sibling's weight.
passes.outcome: 22 rows, 6 retailers, 21 verified prices, 7 published weights, 2 new rows and 3 new flags, 0 hard failures. The integrity audit was re-run after this pass and its output is reproduced below. Recommended for every future review of this repo: re-open every source link, ask 'where is the official source, and what date was it read?', and re-run scripts/audit.py — anything that cannot answer that question is unverified and belongs on the Flagged page, not in a price cell.

not_reverified_this_pass: Brilliant Earth's seller-level facts (phone 800.691.0952, 30-day returns) were not re-fetched during Pass 2; they remain as recorded by the earlier pass and stay flagged REPUTATION_NOT_VERIFIED like every other seller.
Seller reputation was not verified for any retailer. No review or complaint data was collected by any pass, so every seller row keeps an empty reputation field and a REPUTATION_NOT_VERIFIED flag.
No item has been assayed or XRF-tested. Purity is the retailer's claim plus the statutory tolerance, nothing more.
Prices are a 22 October 2026 snapshot; nothing on this site re-polls a retailer, so re-check the source link before buying.
